definitions.explanation: The fifth month of the year. Features Golden Week, Japan's longest holiday period.

examples.japanese: {五月|ごがつ}{五日|いつか}は{子|こ}どもの{日|ひ}です。
{五月|ごがつ}は{気持|きも}ちがいい{季節|きせつ}です。
{五月|ごがつ}の{終|お}わりごろから{雨|あめ}が{多|おお}くなります。
examples.english: It starts to rain more toward the end of May.

examples.japanese: {五月|ごがつ}は{休|やす}みが{多|おお}いので、{旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}く{人|ひと}がたくさんいます。
examples.english: There are many holidays in May, so a lot of people go on trips.

notes:
{五月|ごがつ} is the fifth month of the year.

JAPANESE MONTHS:
All months use number + {月|がつ}:
- {一月|いちがつ} (January) through {十二月|じゅうにがつ} (December)

GOLDEN WEEK HOLIDAYS:
- {昭和|しょうわ}の{日|ひ} (April 29): Showa Day
- {憲法|けんぽう}{記念|きねん}{日|び} (May 3): Constitution Day
- みどりの{日|ひ} (May 4): Greenery Day
- {子|こ}どもの{日|ひ} (May 5): Children's Day

MAY TRADITIONS:
- {鯉|こい}のぼり: carp streamers (displayed for Children's Day)
- {柏餅|かしわもち}: rice cakes wrapped in oak leaves
- {五月人形|ごがつにんぎょう}: warrior dolls

SEASON:
May is late spring ({春|はる}) with pleasant weather. The rainy season ({梅雨|つゆ}) typically begins in late May or early June.
